target_definition: Every active month (at least 3 trades) must have gross profit / gross loss >= 1.20 in both training and holdout; aggregate PF must also be >= 1.20 in both windows.
method: Chronological training/holdout split is aligned to realized exit months so a multi-session position cannot spill across the validation boundary. Predeclared lagged index indicator and regime signals choose between same-date, same-expiry, Call/Put outcomes at ATM, one-strike ITM and one-strike OTM moneyness, plus bounded-risk ATM debit and credit vertical spread outcomes at one-, two- and three-available-strike widths for one-, two-, three- and five-session holds. Long-option candidates include ATM, one-step ITM, and one-, two-, three- and five-step OTM contracts. Both spread types require liquid observed legs at entry and exit, reject impossible marks beyond their strike width. Default research evaluates one historical lot without an account-level affordability or risk-budget gate; an optional risk_per_trade_pct can enable that separate filter. Option-chain PCR, OI build-up and ATM straddle/realised-volatility proxies are aligned to the prior completed signal session. Option outcomes are rebuilt from observed BSE daily candles, with the exact same contract held through the selected exit session. A missing side is not fabricated; that direction is skipped when its observed quote is unavailable. Signals use only the last completed index session before entry. Candidate rules are ranked using training only; holdout is separate. Rolling selectors use only prior complete calendar months. Gap-fade variants are gated by lagged volatility, ADX, RSI, MACD, EMA and completed-candle rejection conditions.
option_market_features: near-ATM put/call volume and open-interest ratios
call/put open-interest changes matched to premium changes
ATM straddle premium versus trailing realised-volatility proxy
credit_spread_risk_budget: No ₹10,000 affordability or 2% risk cap is applied in signal research; each observed strategy outcome uses one historical lot.
position_sizing: One historical lot per candidate outcome; no account affordability filter or capital-based position sizing.
selector_note: Rolling selector is a diagnostic paper-research rule, not a shared-capital portfolio: strategy switches across month boundaries may overlap positions. It goes to cash when no signal has at least 20 prior trades and prior-window PF >= 1.20.
caveat: This is a historical screening experiment, not a live profit guarantee. Option outcomes use one-lot EOD marks and estimated costs; intraday execution, queue position and slippage may differ. Repeated research iterations create selection bias, so any promising rule needs a new prospective paper-trading period before live deployment.
